meta.name: Panchayat S03
meta.description:
Panchayat is a comedy-drama, which captures the journey of an engineering graduate Abhishek, who for lack of a better job option joins as secretary of a panchayat office in a remote village of Uttar Pradesh. Stuck between crazy villagers and a difficult village lifestyle Abhishek starts his job with the sole motivation of getting out of there as soon as possible, for which he even prepares for CAT.

Rated TV-14 · Returning Series · First aired 5 Mar 2020 · India · Language: Hindi · 30 min
Studio: The Viral Fever · Network: Prime Video

videos.title: Rangbaazi
videos.overview: Pradhan's desperate attempt to prevent Abhishek's impending transfer intensifies the conflict between the Pradhan gang and the MLA. Prahlad finds it difficult to make peace with his new reality.

videos.title: Gaddha
videos.overview: Abhishek returns with the resolve of staying away from the village politics. Fearing the loss of public reputation, Pradhan and Manju Devi need Abhishek's help to handle a rebel.

videos.title: Ghar Ya Eent-Patthar?
videos.overview: After Bhushan senses an opportunity to attack Pradhan, Abhishek jumps into damage control mode. Prahlad doesn't like the way Pradhan uses Abhishek for political benefit.

videos.title: Atma Manthan
videos.overview: The final blow to Pradhan's reputation comes after he gets accused of partiality in a welfare scheme implementation. Meanwhile to topple Pradhan's rule, Bhushan allies with the MLA.

videos.title: Shanti Samjhauta
videos.overview: Manju Devi reluctantly agrees to Bhushan's proposal of entering into a peace agreement with the MLA. Abhishek too gives his nod as it's impossible to get the road built without MLA's support.

videos.title: Chingaari
videos.overview: To fix their dented image, the Pradhan gang sets a trap to capitalize on a lethal mistake committed by the MLA. Amidst all the political chaos an unexpected news brings joy to the Pradhan gang.

videos.title: Shola
videos.overview: Fully aware of his actions, MLA not only walks into the trap but also raises the stakes. Pradhan gang needs to walk the talk or it's all over.

videos.title: Hamla
videos.overview: Finally, Pradhan rallies the whole Phulera behind him to fight one last battle for glory. Abhishek finds himself too deep into the murky waters of village politics and loses his objectivity.
